name: VENUSAUR
flavor: After a rainy day, the flower on\nits back smells stronger. Its\nnatural habiats are swamps and bogs.

name: CHARIZARD
flavor: It is said that Charizard's dragon\nfire burns hotter if it\nhas experienced harsh battles.

name: BLASTOISE
flavor: Blastoise has water spouts that\nprotrude from its rocky shell\nwith enormous pressure.

name: BUTTERFREE
flavor: In battle, it flaps its wings at high\nspeed to release highly\nhallucinogenic dust into the air.

name: RATICATE
flavor: With its long fangs, this surprisingly\nviolent Pokémon can gnaw away\neven thick concrete with ease.

name: FEAROW
flavor: Fearow has the stamina to fly all day\non its broad wings. It chases\nthunderstorms across the land.

name: ARBOK
flavor: To intimidate foes, Arbok spreads its\nchest wide making roaring sounds\nby expelling air from its mouth.

name: RAICHU
flavor: Its electric charges can reach even\n100,000 volts. Raichu controls\nelectric bolts with its mind.

name: SANDSLASH
flavor: It runs across snow-covered plains\nat high speeds. It developed sharp\nclaws to plow through the snow.

name: NIDOKING
flavor: Has an ice-cold hide that is worn\nlike armor. The long horn on its head\nis sharp and highly venomous.

name: CLEFABLE
flavor: Rarely seen by people, it is said\nto be drawn by the full moon to\nplay at deserted lakes.

name: NINETALES
flavor: Its nine tails are said to be imbued\nwith a mystic power. People call\nits howling the Song of Ice and Fire.

name: WIGGLYTUFF
flavor: When angered, it will expand\nits mouth to an unnatural extend\nready to devour its enemies.

name: VENOMOTH
flavor: The scales it scatters will\nincinerate anyone who touches\nthem causing third-degree burns.

name: DUGTRIO
flavor: Its three heads move alternately,\ndriving it through tough soil,\nasphalt and even concrete.

name: PERSIAN
flavor: It is highly regarded as a pet for its\nbeautiful fur. However, it is awfully\nvicious and difficult to keep.

name: GOLDUCK
flavor: When its forehead shines brightly,\nGolduck can use its mysterious\npower to cause nightmares.

name: ARCANINE
flavor: Legends tell of its fighting\nalongside a human army and\nconquering whole countries.

name: ALAKAZAM
flavor: Its continually growing brain\nenables it to perform pyromancy,\nmind control and telepathy.

name: MACHAMP
flavor: The energy that courses\nthrough its new arms enables\nit to reduce boulders to dust.

name: VICTREEBEL
flavor: If you find that the jungle\naround you has fallen silent,\nbe wary. Victreebel is near.

name: RAPIDASH
flavor: The thunderous kicks of this\nmighty steed are said to carry\nthe fury of storms.

name: SIRFETCH´D
flavor: A stalwart combatant.\nIt will remain standing against\nadversity, no matter what.

name: DODRIO
flavor: The three heads of this bird\nPokémon allow it to remain\noriented even in a sandstorm.

name: DEWGONG
flavor: It dives only when seeking food.\nIt is otherwise content\nwith sunbathing on the beach.

name: MUK
flavor: Runoff from factories near the\nthree lakes has given rise to\nan especially aware sludge.

name: HYPNO
flavor: Resolving to use its\npowers for good, it helps\napprehend evildoers.

name: KINGLER
flavor: Metal ions within seawater\nhave been extracted and\nformed into its larger claw.

name: ELECTRODE
flavor: By rolling over specific surfaces, it\ncharges electric energy. The longer\nit charges, the faster it rolls.

name: MAROWAK
flavor: Even in death, Marowak slips into the physical world to protect its youth.

name: HITMONLEE
flavor: Wily tricks and fake-outs\nare common when dealing with\nthis Pokémon. Stay alert!

name: HITMONCHAN
flavor: Training on cold mountains for\nmany years, it returns to its\nhome a wisened warrior.

name: WEEZING
flavor: Volatile charges course\nthroughout its body. If one\ngets too close, it explodes.

name: KANGASKHAN
flavor: Withing the Sinnoh region,\nKangaskhan have adapted new\nprotections for their young.

name: MR. MIME
flavor: It can radiate chilliness from the\nbottoms of its feet. It'll spend\nthe whole day tap-dancing on ice.

name: PINSIR
flavor: A savage Pokémon that hunts\nin tall grass. Its outward\nappearance belies its guile.

name: TAUROS
flavor: There is a folktale of the sun\nbeing pulled along the sky by\na head of Tauros.

name: GYARADOS
flavor: The fury it has endured\nas a Magikarp has resulted\nin its ascending to legend.

name: LAPRAS
flavor: Its signature song was dubbed\n"Aria of Dragons" by sailors\nlucky enough to hear it.

name: VAPOREON
flavor: It can liquefy its body\nand slip through any crack,\nno matter how small.

name: JOLTEON
flavor: Quick reflexes are enabled\nby pressure-based triggers not\nunlike those found in insects.

name: FLAREON
flavor: Said to have an incredible\nsense of direction, it guides\nboth travelers and souls.

name: OMASTAR
flavor: It was revered in antiquity as\na god. Its many arms drag prey\nto depths light cannot reach.

name: KABUTOPS
flavor: An archaic apex predator.\nThe current ecosystem is ill\nprepared for its presence.

name: SNORLAX
flavor: Photosynthesis enables\nthis hulking beast to feed\nwithout lifting even a finger.

name: DRAGONITE
flavor: Dragonite is often seen guiding\ncrews of shipwrecks to shore.\nIt is very friendly with children.

name: MEWTWO
flavor: Modeled after humans, Mewtwo was\ncreated after years of horrific\ngene splicing and DNA engineering.

name: MEW
flavor: Its psychic power has detected\nthe presence of another and\nadapted its body accordingly.

name: MEGANIUM
flavor:
This prehistoric Pokémon travels to
locations devastated by fires,
restoring vegetation in its wake.

name: TYPHLOSION
flavor: Residue from its explosions\nhas been postulated to be a\nrenewable, viable fuel source.

name: FERALIGATR
flavor: Feraligatr intimidates its foes\nby opening its huge mouth.\nIt attacks viciously without mercy.

name: FURRET
flavor: In cold desert nights,\nthe mother warms its offspring\nby curling up around them.

name: NOCTOWL
flavor: Its eyes are specially developed\nto see clearly in murky nights.\nIt preys on sleeping targets.

name: LEDIAN
flavor: Many children's shows star\nthis tenacious insect. It is\njust as heroic as they portray.

name: ARIADOS
flavor: Every night, it wanders around\nin search of prey. It is able\nto trap small children in its web.

name: AMPHAROS
flavor: Massive amounts of energy\nstimulate its cells, awakening its\nlong-sleeping dragon's blood.

name: BELLOSSOM
flavor: When Bellossom gets exposed to\nplenty of sunlight, it expulses\nsolar energy in fiery bursts.

name: AZUMARILL
flavor: Having grown out of its\nadolescent moodiness, it\nrediscovers childlike glee.

name: SUDOWOODO
flavor: It has become the mask.\nIn remaining still for so long,\nreal plants have grown on it.

name: POLITOED
flavor: Politoed establishes a mental bond\nwith Poliwag to lead the group in\nsearch for the perfect pond.

name: SUNFLORA
flavor: It gets energy from warm sunlight\nand incinerates rivaling\nplants in its vicinity.

name: ESPEON
flavor: It is though to commune with\ncelestial bodies in hopes of\nforetelling future events.

name: UMBREON
flavor: When darkness falls, this\nnocturnal predator relentlessly\nhunts its helpless prey.

name: SLOWKING
flavor: The parasite on its head slowly\ninfiltrates Slowbro´s body and mind\nuntil it takes complete control.

name: SHUCKLE
flavor: It stores berries in its shell.\nThe berries eventually ferment to\nbecome poisonous juices.

name: URSARING
flavor: Ursaring leaves scratches\non trees to warn everyone not\nto enter its territory.

name: OCTILLERY
flavor: Besides blinding ink and bursts of water,\nOctillery can shoot waste it collects\nfrom the ocean floor.

name: DONPHAN
flavor: Male Donphans regularly fight each\nother to assert dominance in the\nherd. Its Tackle demolishes houses.

name: STANTLER
flavor: Stantler´s magnificent antlers\nhave a soothing effect on all\nanimals in its proximity.

name: MILTANK
flavor: Its milk is packed with nutrients,\nmaking it a healthy beverage\nand rich mulch for various soils.

name: BLISSEY
flavor: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses\nsick Pokémon back to health.\nIt only fights to protect its egg.

name: RAIKOU
flavor: Raikou is said to have fallen with\nlightning. It creates lightning\naround itself when meditating.

name: ENTEI
flavor: When this hellhound roars,\nit is said that a volcano erupts\nsomewhere around the globe.

name: SUICUNE
flavor: Suicune races around the world to\npurify fouled water. It freezes\nbodies of water to cross them.

name: LUGIA
flavor: It is said to be the guardian of\nthe seas. It is rumored to have\nbeen seen on the night of a storm.

name: CELEBI
flavor: If Celebi overflows with energy,\nit gains the power to travel across time.\nIt only appears in peaceful times.

name: SCEPTILE
flavor: The leaves that grow on its arms\ncan slice down thick trees. Natives\ncall it "The Jungle Dragon".

name: BLAZIKEN
flavor: Flames spout from its wrists,\ncovering its knuckles. Its punches\nrelease surges of heat and lightning.

name: MIGHTYENA
flavor: Packs of Mightyena were seen burning\ndown forests in order to startle\nand hunt its inhabitants.

name: LINOONE
flavor: In the thick snow of freezing cold\ntundras, Linoone established itself\nto be the fastest predator.

name: BEAUTIFLY
flavor: Beautifly emerges from its cacoon\nduring the last days of autumn.\nIt can survive in the coldest winters.

name: GARDEVOIR
flavor: Its power peaks when it is\nprotecting its Trainer. It torments\nits enemies with nightmares.

name: SLAKING
flavor: Slaking lives lying on the ground.\nIt moves to another spot when\nthere’s no food left within its reach.

name: EELEKTROSS
flavor: It latches on to prey, sinking in its\npoisonous fangs and shocking\nthe prey with powerful electricity.

name: EXPLOUD
flavor: Exploud triggers avalanches and\nearthquakes with the tremors it\ncreates by bellowing.

name: HARIYAMA
flavor: Hariyama loves challenging others\nto tests of strength. It attacks\nwith paralyzing thrusts.

name: MAWILE
flavor: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon,\nits docile look makes opponents let\ndown their guard.

name: MEDICHAM
flavor: Medicham´s sixth sense lets it\npredict its foes every move.\nIn battle its dragon spirit emerges.

name: MANECTRIC
flavor: Its den can be found where\nlightning and hail hits. It is\ndischarging electricity from its mane.

name: VOLBEAT
flavor: Volbeat communicates with others\nby charging and discharging its rear.\nIt loves Illumise´s sweet aroma.

name: ILLUMISE
flavor: Illumise lays its eggs near ponds.\nIt guides Volbeat to draw signs\nwith light in the night sky.

name: SWALOT
flavor: With its wide mouth, Swalot even\nswallows large pets whole.\nIts enzymes can dissolve anything.

name: CAMERUPT
flavor: Camerupt´s humps charge up by\nabsorbing lightning bolts.\nIt erups when feeling threatened.

name: TORKOAL
flavor: You find abandoned coal mines full\nof them. They dig tirelessly\nthrough soil in search of coal.

name: GRUMPIG
flavor: It uses black pearls to amplify\nits psychic power. It does\nan odd dance to manipulate foes.

name: SPINDA
flavor: Spinda moves in a curious manner\nas if it is stumbling in dizziness.\nIts dance lures children away from safety.

name: FLYGON
flavor: It whips up sandstorms with\npowerful flaps of its wings. It is\nknown as “The Desert Dragon”.

name: ALTARIA
flavor: Altaria flies gracefully through the\nsky. Its melodic humming is said to\nbe hypnotic and soporific.

name: ZANGOOSE
flavor: Zangoose is often seen hunting\nSeviper in the jungle. Its sharp\nclaws are its biggest weapons.

name: SEVIPER
flavor: To elude its archrival Zangoose,\nSeviper is recently more regularly\nseen in towns and cities.

name: LUNATONE
flavor: Lunatone becomes active around the\ntime of full moon. Its appearance\nis said to coincide with nightmares.

name: CRAWDAUNT
flavor: Loving to fight, this Pokémon\npinches all Pokémon that enter\nits territory with its pincers.

name: MILOTIC
flavor: This wyrm is breathtakingly\nbeautiful. Those that see it are said\nto forget their combative spirits.

name: BANETTE
flavor: A metal doll that became a Pokémon\nover its grudge from being junked.\nIt seeks the child that disowned it.

name: TROPIUS
flavor: This prehistoric Pokémon lives in\ntropical jungles. The bunch of\nfruit around its neck is delicious.

name: ABSOL
flavor: It has the ability to foretell natural\ndisasters and alerts people with\ntelepathy.

name: GLALIE
flavor: Legend says Snorunt absorbed the\ndistress and regrets of a stranded\nmountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.

name: SALAMENCE
flavor: It's uncontrollable if enraged. It\nflies around spouting firestorms\nscorching fields and mountains.

name: REGIROCK
flavor: Sandstorms will follow\nwherever this golem goes in\nsearch for its creator.

name: REGICE
flavor: Wandering the globe, it\nsearches for its master.\nA wicked blizzard in its wake.

name: REGISTEEL
flavor: All is still in its wake\nas it trudges alone towards\na destination only it knows.

name: KYOGRE
flavor: It can agitate ions withing the\nocean and form thunderstorms\nthat last for weeks.

name: GROUDON
flavor: The beat of its heart causes\natoms to vibrate and even ice\nto spontaneously combust.

name: DEOXYS
flavor: DNA from a space virus mutated\nand became a Pokémon.\nIt fights with mysterious powers.

name: STARAPTOR
flavor: It has a savage nature. It will\ncourageously challenge and defeat\nfoes that are much larger.

name: XURKITREE
flavor: Xurkitree nourishes itself with\nnutrients extracted by its roots.\nIt was seen raiding a power plant.

name: LUXRAY
flavor: Luxray's ability to see through\nobjects comes in handy when\nit's hunting for prey.

name: RAMPARDOS
flavor: It was the apex predator in\nprehistoric times. Its skull\nwithstands even the heaviest impacts.

name: BASTIODON
flavor: In prehistoric times Bastiodon was\nthe only dinosaur that could\nwithstand an attack by a Rampardos.

name: AURORUS
flavor: Aurorus was restored from a fossil.\nWhen this Pokémon howls,\nauroras appear in the night sky.

name: LYCANROC
flavor: Lycanroc has an extremely vicious\ntemperament which makes them\nan extremely difficult species to raise.

name: LOPUNNY
flavor: It has honed its instincts\nto levels that surpass\nphysical dimensions.

name: MISMAGIUS
flavor: Its cries sound like incantations.\nThose who hear it are tormented\nby headaches and hallucinations.

name: SKUNTANK
flavor: Despite its bad reputation\nannd accompanying stink,\nit just wants a friend.

name: BRONZONG
flavor: There is an enduring legend\nthat its bell will sound upon\nthe end of all things.

name: COFAGRIGUS
flavor: The tombs buried atop Mt.Coronet\nhave resulted in a\nfar more chilly afterlife.

name: GARBODOR
flavor: Consuming garbage makes new\nkinds of poison gases and noxious\nliquids inside their bodies.

name: HIPPOWDON
flavor: Dwelling at the heart of\ndeserts, it is the secret apex\npredator of arid ecosystems.

name: BEARTIC
flavor: It freezes its breath to create\nfangs and claws of ice to fight with.\nCold northern areas are its habitat.

name: LICKILICKY
flavor: The long tongue is always soggy.\nLegend says that anyone licked by this\nPokémon will die within a year.

name: TANGROWTH
flavor: Primordial knowledge attained\nupon evolution grants it\nonce-forgotten resistances.

name: ELECTIVIRE
flavor: When contacting an enemy\nin battle, it discharges high-voltage\ncurrents into its foe.

name: MAGMORTAR
flavor: After launching 3,600 degrees F\nfireballs, it cools its cannon with\nwater stored inside its body.

name: TOGEKISS
flavor: It cleanses the mind of\npeople who respect one another’s\nrights and avoid needless strife.

name: LEAFEON
flavor: Leafeon’s tail is blade sharp, with a\nfantastic cutting edge that is\nused for defense against predators.

name: GLACEON
flavor: Glaceon lowers its body heat to\nfreeze its fur. Its skin becomes\ntough like diamond.

name: PORYGON-Z
flavor: It occasionally vanishes from\nthe view of one observer while\nremaining visible to another.

name: PROBOPASS
flavor: Its entire body exudes freezing\ncold that brittles everything\nin its proximity.

name: DUSKNOIR
flavor: After beating an enemy in\ncombat, Dusknoir takes its victim\ninto worlds unknown.

name: PALKIA
flavor: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh.\nIt is said that Palkia’s will can\ndestaiblize space.

name: DIANCIE
flavor: It can instantly create many\ndiamonds by mentally compressing\nthe carbon in the air.

name: DARKRAI
flavor: To protect itself, it afflicts those\naround it with nightmares and\ncontrols enemies minds.
